headline: Kenya Reassigns $349 Million Bomas Project Contract to Chinese Firm CRBC
summary: The Kenyan government terminated Turkish contractor Summa's contract for the Bomas infrastructure project and reassigned it to China Road and Bridge Corporation, raising project costs to 45.1 billion shillings.
why: CRBC is a major state-owned Chinese engineering contractor operating large-scale public infrastructure projects across Africa.

impacts.name: Kenya
impacts.why: Contract repricing increases public capital spending requirements for national infrastructure.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
